verdict.rationale: Kong's AI Gateway advertises MCP governance, security, observability, and auto-generation of MCP servers from REST APIs (kong-docs-3, kong-gh-6, kong-gh-15), and Insomnia's AI features explicitly mention 'MCP Servers and Clients, which connect to external AI-ready tools and resources' (kong-docs-25). However, this is framed primarily as gateway-level traffic control/governance rather than Kong itself consuming external MCP tool servers as an agent, and there's no hands-on evidence of the plug-in/tool-use flow working end-to-end.
